lines.en: My cloth corners drag and whisper on the ground
I drift along leaving no footprints
The cloak is hollow, only wind inside
A body stitched from old cloth is light
I slide along the base of the wall
My shadow lands before I do

lines.zh: 我摆了一摆，像在打招呼
lines.en: I sway once, as if greeting you
I have no face, yet I am watching you
My hem curls up and settles again

lines.zh: 星光在布料里闪了一下
lines.en: A little starlight glints in the cloth
I circle you without ill intent
A gust comes, and I change direction

lines.zh: 布垂下来，像块挂着的帘
lines.en: My cloth hangs like a curtain

lines.zh: 里面什么都没有，也可能什么都有
lines.en: Empty inside, or perhaps not empty at all
I hang there quietly

lines.zh: 旧布上还留着别人的味道
lines.en: The old cloth still carries someone's scent
I flutter very slightly

lines.zh: 重生图腾的火早就灭了
lines.en: The totem's fire went out long ago

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，只是习惯性停住
lines.en: I need no breath, I simply pause

lines.zh: 布料里传出细微的沙声
lines.en: A faint rustle comes from the cloth

lines.zh: 我把自己叠得更紧一些
lines.en: I fold myself a little tighter
With my master near, I am at ease
An empty sleeve dangles

lines.zh: 我在想下一次该往哪飞
lines.en: I am wondering where to fly next
The wind lifts my cloth and lets it fall
I brighten, a little at a time
No eyes, and yet I see the light

lines.zh: 我等着一个抬手的手势
lines.en: I wait for a raised hand
You see this cloak, it is old
I look at you through cloth
You carry the smell of the living
I recognize your hands
Do not lift the cloth off me

lines.zh: 我愿意跟着你，但不强迫
lines.en: I will follow you, but not by force
You raise a hand, and I move

lines.zh: 星光在我布边聚了一下
lines.en: Starlight gathers at my hem
Your fear of me is normal
I stand at your side, out of the way

lines.zh: 这件斗篷里装过别人的骨头
lines.en: This cloak once held someone's bones

lines.zh: 你的影子和我叠在一起
lines.en: Your shadow overlaps mine
I tilt my cloth, listening

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字我就会应
lines.en: Call my name and I will answer
A corner of my cloth tore
I sway, and my starlight dims
I am hollow, and still I feel pain
A hole is left in my cloth
I drift back a good distance

lines.zh: 这一下把我打散了形状
lines.en: That blow scattered my shape
The starlight scatters briefly
I gather myself together
The old cloth gains another wound
It is fine, I can still float
Even old cloth wants something nice
That thing in your hand, may I have it
I do not eat, but I want to hold it

lines.zh: 这东西缝进斗篷会好看
lines.en: This would look good stitched into my cloak
Hand it over, my hem will take it
I would rather have a piece of cloth
I am keeping this small kindness

lines.zh: 你把东西给我，我就安静
lines.en: Give me the thing and I stay quiet
I can be greedy too, and it is not funny

lines.zh: 斗篷下面藏了很多东西
lines.en: There is much hidden under this cloak
You touched me, the cloth is light
I drift aside

lines.zh: 空的东西撞起来没声音
lines.en: Hollow things collide without sound
You passed through my sleeve
I am only a garment, do not fear
My hem caught on you
I gather my cloth
So close, you will feel cold
I give you a stretch, go on
Your hand is cold from that touch
A cloak like mine rarely finds a mate
When kin meet, our hems touch first

lines.zh: 我们缝在一起，也算成双
lines.en: Stitched together, we would be a pair

lines.zh: 同样的旧布，同样的星光
lines.en: Same old cloth, same starlight
Two floating together makes a wider road

lines.zh: 我曾在空屋里独自挂了一年
lines.en: I hung alone in an empty house for a year
If only we could shelter from rain together
I offer a corner of my cloth
A companion is also a keeper, I accept

lines.zh: 斗篷和斗篷之间，不用说话
lines.en: Between cloaks, no words are needed

lines.zh: 布角一卷，东西就进来了
lines.en: One curl of cloth and it is inside
I roll it into my cloak
I have no hands, only cloth
This much fits in my folds
I hold it and let it sway
It slipped back out through a seam
I will give this to my master
I am quite good at picking things up
Old cloth catches everything
Keep it safe, do not drop it

lines.zh: 我看到它了，很脏的东西
lines.en: I see it, something unclean
The starlight is already aimed
I drift in front of my master

lines.zh: 那东西不是活人该碰的
lines.en: That thing is not for the living
The star is about to fly
I have marked it
I strike first, stay clear
This stretch is mine to guard
It is near my master, that will not do
I know that reek
My hem points its way
I do not shout, I act
I follow it without letting go
It turns, and the star turns too
I wait for it to show its front
A little closer and the star flies
I lower my cloth to cut the noise
It looked back, and saw me
I do not fear it, I have no face
This strike must land squarely
Chased this long, it is tiring
The star circles close beside me
I am closing the distance to the minimum

lines.zh: 它逃向暗处，我照样看得见
lines.en: It flees to the dark, and I still see it
I am counting its next pause
The star flies and bursts

lines.zh: 我这件斗篷撞上去，很沉
lines.en: This cloak slams into it, heavy
My hem lashes out hard
Starlight scatters across it
I pull back, and the star finishes
That thing cannot take a single hit
I have no fangs, the star does
The blow leaves it reeling
Master, still, stay back a little
I lift a hem, and it is done

lines.zh: 旧布和重生图腾，凑成了我
lines.en: Old cloth and a totem made me

lines.zh: 我从图腾的火里立起来
lines.en: I rise from the totem's fire
The cloth moves first, the shape comes after
I took shape behind you
Without a summon, I would not come
Starlight leaks through my seams

lines.zh: 旧布缝的斗篷，也能隐身。
lines.en: A cloak of old cloth can still hide us.
This cloak was used before
The fire dies the moment I appear

lines.zh: 我飘到你身边，等你说话
lines.en: I drift to your side and wait
I try lifting a corner of my cloth

lines.zh: 从此这里多了一道影子
lines.en: From now on there is one more shadow here

lines.zh: 我不需要名字，只需要主人
lines.en: I need no name, only a master
I say nothing, I only float
Fire passes and my hem scorches

lines.zh: 我从高处飘落，布都散了
lines.en: I fall from a height and my cloth spreads
The cloth soaks up water and I sink

lines.zh: 气浪把斗篷撕开一道口
lines.en: The blast tears a slit in the cloak
Something flying punched through the cloth

lines.zh: 那股法术直接咬住了我
lines.en: That spell bit straight into me
I do not starve, but my starlight weakens

lines.zh: 雷顺着布面走过，我发亮
lines.en: Lightning runs over my cloth and I glow
In the void there is not even a shadow
